usage: agentware plan new [-h] [--format {text,json}] --title TITLE
                          [--max-iterations MAX_ITERATIONS] [--self-extension]
                          [--force] [--author AUTHOR] [--auto]
                          [--generated-by GENERATED_BY] [--trigger TRIGGER]
                          [--evidence EVIDENCE] [--target TARGET]
                          [--context CONTEXT]
                          feature

positional arguments:
  feature               feature slug; dir under work/

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --title TITLE         human plan title
  --max-iterations MAX_ITERATIONS
                        loop iteration budget
  --self-extension      seed the R-PKG-03 self-extension warning block
  --force               overwrite an existing plan.md
  --author AUTHOR       provenance author handle (default: the per-user handle
                        if set). Visible metadata only — no effect on
                        execution or retrieval.
  --auto                emit a WORKORDER under work/auto/<slug>/ (the emitter
                        prepends 'auto/'); requires --generated-by and
                        --trigger, seeds provenance headers + a knowledge-dir
                        target, and enforces the emit-time governance guards
                        g1/g2/g3
  --generated-by GENERATED_BY
                        [--auto] the tool/agent that generated this workorder
                        (provenance)
  --trigger TRIGGER     [--auto] the event that triggered it (provenance)
  --evidence EVIDENCE   [--auto] optional evidence path(s) (provenance)
  --target TARGET       [--auto] target directory (repeatable; default: the
                        knowledge dir). Kernel paths are refused (g1).
  --context CONTEXT     UNTRUSTED caller-supplied candidate text, quoted
                        verbatim inside a fenced block in the Context section
                        ONLY (never a Verify/exec line). Forged headers and
                        fence-breakouts are neutralized; kernel-path
                        candidates are refused (g1). The emit seam the dream
                        classify drain uses for mined preferences.
